featured_reviews.name: AMAN AZMI
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing and distressing experience with this insurance company. At a time when I was in urgent need of funds to clear my dues, I received a call offering me a solution. I was promised a loan of ₹10 lakh through their banking partner if I purchased a Bharti AXA Elite Advantage policy with a premium of ₹50,000. They claimed that the loan interest would be offset by the returns from the policy at maturity.

Under pressure and trusting their promise, I ended up purchasing four policies, each worth ₹50,000. I received the hard copies within a week, but after that, the agents completely disappeared—phones switched off, no follow-up, and no support. It became clear that this was a well-orchestrated scam.

It’s shocking that an insurance company would stoop so low by hiring third parties to mislead and exploit customers. I strongly urge everyone to be cautious and never buy any insurance from Bhartia Axa..
